name: Return to Onu
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening.  Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.

Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
narrative.objectives: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.

Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 17 to 20, 6,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Cave Mushrooms
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Scaber Stalks and 1 Death Cap to Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine.

quests.name: Onu
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.

quests.name: The Master's Glaive
quests.objectiveText: Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl.

quests.name: The Twilight Camp
quests.objectiveText: Find a clue in the Twilight's Hammer camp at the Master's Glaive.

quests.name: Return to Onu
quests.objectiveText: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.

quests.name: Mathystra Relics
quests.objectiveText: Bring 6 Mathystra Relics to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients.
